sources.topic: Client/server tags and ping result behavior; pipe sectors, circular overwrite, simultaneous FILE access and retained formatting/memory intent

extended_forms: Configured socket/PIP FILE reads and writes

contract.messaging: Explicit sixteen-tag Messaging bank, combined bounded input/output bytes, supplied host-result table and logical mounted/available/connected flags
contract.socket_files: One text/binary FILE per endpoint; distinct RX/TX; successful reads consume input, writes append output, failed reads retain data/outputs/cursor; EOF rather than transport waits
contract.host_helpers: Explicit feed and output drain, no implicit peer link or callback; availability loss disconnects
contract.file_pipes: Explicit circular byte histories, newest configured sector capacity retained, independent cursors adjusted on overwrite; W clears, A/RW append, reads retain history
contract.metadata: CMOS intent and formatting/record metadata retained; FILE field encoding remains explicit and no native formatting/alignment is applied
contract.namespace: Source, context load and FILE open protect distinct plain/DAQ PIP names; no filesystem fallback
contract.persistence: Checked schemas, logical flags, host results and bounded raw hex; refuse live FILE saves; no cursors or native transport restored

boundaries: No actual sockets, DNS, ping, controller devices, transport callbacks or automatic peers
No blocking/wait/snapshot pipe attributes, formatted dictionary display or generic pipe file-operation routing
Offline connected flags and CMOS intent do not imply native sessions or power-cycle restoration
Native status/timing equivalence and strict mode remain future work
